question: Can progressive profit banking stop ETHUSDT.P 15m runner trades from returning a large favourable excursion without destroying the residual trend tail?

instrument.proxy_note: The bounded OKX swap series is the research proxy for the explicit OKX TradingView venue.

frozen_entry.k1_k2_and_regime_contract: Exact V5 morphology, current-liveness gate, and one-signal-per-regime state from the parent; no ETH entry parameter is tuned.

frozen_execution.same_bar_priority: active stop before any new profit milestone
frozen_execution.gap_stop_fill: bar open when it gaps beyond the active stop
frozen_execution.state_update_timing: milestone, profit floor, and moving-average trail observed on bar t become active for bar t+1

progressive_scaleout.remainder: SMA60 minus direction times one current ATR runner
progressive_scaleout.profit_floor: After each filled tranche, the remaining stop must be at least entry plus direction times full round-trip cost divided by remaining fraction. If filled without a gap, the aggregate final net cannot fall below already banked gross profit.
progressive_scaleout.claim_limit: Bar-level conservative replay; stop wins when both sides occur in one candle, so no intrabar ordering advantage is assumed.

selection.rank: Among eligible arms, minimize the share of >=first-target excursions finishing non-positive, then maximize robust half-year mean net bp, then retain the larger runner fraction.
selection.robust_score: median half-year mean net bp minus 0.5 times population standard deviation
selection.audit_rule: Freeze the development-selected pair before reading audit outcomes; audit never changes the selected values.
